title: Masjid e Ghadeer e Khumm
introduction:
MASJID-E-GHADEER-E-KHUMM

It is three miles away from Juhfah and two miles away according to another tradition.

Late Shaykh Sadooq (a) has written in Man La Yahzarul Faqih a tradition from I. Sadiq (a) that it is recommended to pray in Masjid Ghadeer-e-Khum.
